# Punctual Plumbers

> Coastal-certified plumbers on the Garden Route, South Africa. Premium plumbing and emergency callouts from Mossel Bay to Storms River since 2009.

## About

- Licensed contractor (PIRB 3419), IOPSA member, compliant with SANS 10252 water services standards.
- Founded 2009; operating across the full Garden Route corridor.
- Specialists in salt-air-rated coastal-grade copper and PEX installations.

## Services

- General Plumbing
- Bathroom Renovations
- Leak Detection
- New Installations
- Geyser Repairs
- Drain Cleaning
- Water Filtration
- Emergency Callouts (24/7)

## Coverage

Mossel Bay, Hartenbos, George, Wilderness, Sedgefield, Knysna, Plettenberg Bay, Nature's Valley, Storms River.
